auditTitle: CRITICAL MATCH VISIBILITY & EVENT LOOKUP RELIABILITY AUDIT

rootCauseDiagnosis.frontendDetails: Sports.jsx previously evaluated active matches ONLY against useLiveScores().matches (the live board). When a match completed or dropped off upstream provider live streams, frontend fell back to an in-memory stub ('This fixture left the live board') without querying the persistent backend endpoint.
rootCauseDiagnosis.databaseDetails: Matches table in PostgreSQL was empty (0 rows) due to legacy foreign key constraints (matches_competition_id_fkey, matches_team1_id_fkey, matches_team2_id_fkey). Applied migration 102 to drop strict FKs and backfilled 150 placed-bet matches (345 matches now persistent).
rootCauseDiagnosis.backendDetails: GET /api/v1/matches/:id and public odds endpoints lacked persistent database fallback and threw 404s for concluded matches instead of returning 200 with NO_LONGER_LIVE / COMPLETED contract.
